title: One machine-readable reading of a drawn tree (ADR-015 amendment 1)
description: The blueprint (docs/proposals/PROPOSAL-agent-framework-blueprint.md, Part VI) draws two trees, UPSTREAM and HOST, as a fixed set of paths that must exist in their drawn place by their drawn name -- the FLOOR, never the ceiling (amendment 1). This is the ONE declaration of that floor for one side; a floor gate is a GENERIC projection of it, never a hand-written list of paths inside an interpreter. A path whose real content belongs to a later link is named `pending` with the link that carries it -- never a fabricated placeholder (Cardinal V).

side.description: Which box of the Part VI drawing this reading is of.

source.description: Where the drawing that this declaration transcribes lives -- file and line range.

path.description: Root-relative, POSIX-formed. A directory path ends in '/'.

drawn_as.description: The label the drawing itself uses for this path, for a reader comparing the two.

pending.description: The link (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, L, or a sub-step of one) whose work gives this path real content. Present only when the path is not yet built for real; its absence from disk is then not a floor failure -- it is printed, not hidden.

capability.description: The id of the one capability whose own `installs` puts this path in place. Present only when the path belongs to a capability that is not always enabled; a row with no `capability` always applies. On a host that has not enabled it, the row is skipped and printed as NOT ENABLED, never counted as a floor failure -- read from that capability's own declaration, never restated here.
